description: Original bounded algebra algorithm with independent finite checks
cost: Ranked zeta transforms F[k,S]=sum_{T subset S,|T|=k}a[T]; H[k,S]=sum_i F[i,S]G[k-i,S]; Mobius invert then return H[|S|,S]. Equal power2 lengths<=4096; modulus998244353. O(d²2^d) time O(d2^d) memory. Bjorklund et al., Fourier meets Mobius, STOC 2007.
forward: Ranked zeta transforms F[k,S]=sum_{T subset S,|T|=k}a[T]; H[k,S]=sum_i F[i,S]G[k-i,S]; Mobius invert then return H[|S|,S]. Equal power2 lengths<=4096; modulus998244353. O(d²2^d) time O(d2^d) memory. Bjorklund et al., Fourier meets Mobius, STOC 2007.
inverse: At validated a,b, any candidate y with y[S] unequal to sum_{T subset S}a[T]b[S xor T] modulo p, or residue>=p, is excluded. Shape-invalid input paired with Ok is excluded.

For observed y retain pairs satisfying every subset convolution equation. Zero a with any b maps to zero; for fixed a with a[0] nonzero the triangular equations uniquely recover b. Raw residue representatives remain ambiguous.
limitations: Partial syntax; finite tests do not prove universal correctness; no allocator failure injection; no executable surrogate
